title: How to (Accidentally) Spot a Baku Gym Guy. Tip #1
body: He calls it zal, never the gym, and he goes six days a week and has opinions about the seventh. Ask about the split. If he answers with a whole weekly schedule, unprompted, in detail, correct. If leg day is genuinely happening, respect. If leg day is theoretical, look at the trousers. It's a sealed deal if he knows the exact time the gym is empty and structures his entire life around it.
caption:
Tip #1 😭 zal-a gedənlər, this is you.

title: How to (Accidentally) Spot a Baku Gym Guy. Tip #2
body: Watch the food. Chicken and rice out of a container, at his desk, at 1pm, every single day, and he has stopped noticing that it's sad. Ask about protein. It came from iHerb, from Turkey in a suitcase, or from a guy who sells it out of a car park, and each answer tells you what tier he's at. It's a sealed deal if he's ever refused a plate of dolma from a relative and had to explain macros to a grandmother.
caption:
Tip #2 😭 zal-a gedənlər, this is you.

title: How to (Accidentally) Spot a Baku Gym Guy. Tip #3
body: Ask what he weighs and then ask what he wants to weigh. The gap is either four kilos or forty and neither man is happy. There is a bulk and a cut and they run on a calendar he takes seriously. Ramadan is a cut whether he intended it or not. It's a sealed deal if he has a photo from 2019 on his phone that he shows people as motivation and it's genuinely a different person.
caption:
Tip #3 😭 zal-a gedənlər, this is you.

title: How to (Accidentally) Spot a Baku Gym Guy. Tip #4
body: Watch the mirror situation. Not vanity, documentation. Same corner, same light, same day of the week, and 90 percent of them never get posted. There's a folder. The folder is between him and God. It's a sealed deal if he has ever retaken one because the light was different and it would have ruined the comparison.
caption:
Tip #4 😭 zal-a gedənlər, this is you.

title: How to (Accidentally) Spot a Baku Gym Guy. Tip #5
body: Ask about supplements and see how far he goes. Creatine is normal and he'll say it immediately. Pre-workout he'll mention with a laugh. Then there's a pause, and what comes after the pause is the actual answer. Everyone in every Baku gym knows who's on what and nobody says it out loud, ever. It's a sealed deal if he says "təbii" a little too quickly.
caption:
Tip #5 😭 zal-a gedənlər, this is you.

title: How to (Accidentally) Spot a Baku Gym Guy. Tip #6
body: Look at where he trains. World Gym and the big chains are one crowd. The basement gym in a residential block with equipment from 1990 and a coach who has been there since it opened is a completely different one, and that second man is stronger. Ask which. It's a sealed deal if his coach has been shouting the same four words at him for six years and it still works.
caption:
Tip #6 😭 zal-a gedənlər, this is you.

title: How to (Accidentally) Spot a Baku Gym Guy. Tip #7
body: Ask about Boulevard. Every serious one runs it, early, when it's empty and the Caspian is flat, and he will tell you it's the best hour of the day and he is correct. He has a route. He has a time he's trying to beat. It's a sealed deal if he knows exactly which stretch has the headwind and plans the direction around it.
caption:
Tip #7 😭 zal-a gedənlər, this is you.
